title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Branch Service Matrix: Pickup, Delivery, Upgrades and Courtesy Classes
content:
The rental partner's branch service for Rental Vehicle Coordination differs by class in the notice needed to have the class ready, Saturday pickup, delivery to the repair center, upgrades out of the class, and whether the class may serve a warranty courtesy rental.

## Service matrix

| Rental class | Notice needed (hours) | Saturday pickup | Delivery to the repair center at drop-off | Customer may move up from this class | How a class difference is charged | Usable for a warranty courtesy rental |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Rental | 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Daily rate difference per rental day | Yes |
| Compact Rental | 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Daily rate difference per rental day | Yes |
| Intermediate Rental | 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Daily rate difference per rental day | Yes |
| Full-Size Rental | 4 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Daily rate difference per rental day | No |
| Standard SUV Rental | 4 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Daily rate difference per rental day | No |
| Minivan Rental | 24 | No | No | No | Daily rate difference per rental day | No |

## Meaning of each column

- **Notice needed**: the hours of notice the partner needs to have the class ready (a whole number of hours).
- **Saturday pickup**: whether a Saturday pickup can be arranged.
- **Delivery to the repair center**: whether the partner delivers the rental to the repair center at drop-off.
- **Customer may move up**: whether the customer may move up from this class by paying the difference.
- **How a class difference is charged**: the daily rate difference per rental day.
- **Usable for a warranty courtesy rental**: whether the class may be used for a warranty courtesy rental.

## Notes on the matrix

- The Minivan Rental is the one class with 24 hours of notice, no Saturday pickup, no delivery to the repair center and no move up out of the class.
- Only the Economy, Compact and Intermediate Rental classes are marked usable for a warranty courtesy rental.
- Hypothetical reading: a Full-Size Rental requested for a pickup three hours away has less than the 4 hours of notice its row shows; the same request for a Compact Rental meets the 2 hours its row shows.
